correctness.rationale: Universal containment for U=V\{v} forces at least one private atom d_v in s(v), distinct from all other world labels. Each additional coordinate shared by >=2 worlds defines a graph clique, and the shared coordinates cover all edges, forcing n>=m+theta_e(G). Private-world coordinates plus a coordinate for each clique of an optimal edge cover attain this and realize ALL truth subsets by taking all shared coordinates plus precisely private coordinates of true worlds. The proof handles m=1, edgeless graphs, complete and triangle-free cases and transfers modal formulas via an actual frame isomorphism, not a bounded-morphic surrogate.

value.rationale: The same Boolean representation must support every propositional valuation, so minimizing algebra atoms is a meaningful proof/semantics resource problem. The bound m+theta_e(G) distinguishes dense complete-frame compression (m+1) from triangle-free frames (m+|E|) and can be used independently of proving modal completeness. This is more than a relabeling of theta_e: universal valuation faithfulness mathematically forces an independent private-marker budget.

scientific_limitations: Finite, nonempty reflexive/symmetric frames; one fixed representation realizes all valuations by containment; does not solve formula-specific or bounded-morphic minimization.
